{{Top|leg}}
'''Mono-molecular shielding''' was a type of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] that was tightly bonded at the subatomic level. The shielding was virtually impervious to harm. The underground chambers of the [[Royal Palace of Alderaan|Royal Palace]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] were equipped with [[mono-molecular]] plates, which protected them from the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Extremely expensive and heavily regulated, mono-molecular shielding was only used on parts of the Palace to avoid [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] attention and scrutiny.
